dialogues.en: "Uuuuhhhhnnn...."
dialogues.text: "Uuuuhhhhnnn...."

dialogues.jp:
伸ばした指先に硬い感触を確認し、スイッチを
押す。
dialogues.en: My finger extended to hit the switch on the alarm.
dialogues.text: My finger extended to hit the switch on the alarm.

dialogues.en: "Yaaaawnnn...."
dialogues.text: "Yaaaawnnn...."

dialogues.jp: 二度寝したい衝動を抑え、ベッドから下りる。
dialogues.en:
Fighting off the urge to just fall back into bed again, I
got up.
dialogues.text:
Fighting off the urge to just fall back into bed again, I
got up.

dialogues.jp:
制服に着替え、音夢がいないことを確認して１
階に下りる。
dialogues.en:
I changed into my school uniform and headed downstairs,
finding out that Nemu left early again.
dialogues.text:
I changed into my school uniform and headed downstairs,
finding out that Nemu left early again.

dialogues.jp: 今日の飯はカップ麺かな……。
dialogues.en: Looks like today's breakfast will be cup noodles...
dialogues.text: Looks like today's breakfast will be cup noodles...

dialogues.jp:
窒息しそうなほど桜の花びらの舞う桜並木を抜
けて、校門に｛たど／辿｝り着く。
dialogues.en:
Walking through the Sakura Tree Avenue, almost suffocating
from the absurd number of sakura petals, I reached the
school entrance.
dialogues.text:
Walking through the Sakura Tree Avenue, almost suffocating
from the absurd number of sakura petals, I reached the
school entrance.

dialogues.jp:
そこでは他の風紀委員と一緒に並んで立つ音夢
の姿が見えた。
dialogues.en:
I could see Nemu standing guard near the school gate along
with another Disciplinary Committee member.
dialogues.text:
I could see Nemu standing guard near the school gate along
with another Disciplinary Committee member.

dialogues.jp: （ホント……ご苦労なヤツだ）
dialogues.en: "(She's far too helpful for her own good...)"
dialogues.text: "(She's far too helpful for her own good...)"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉せんぱーい！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpaaaaaaai!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpaaaaaaai!"

dialogues.jp: 背後から、美春の元気な声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: Miharu's cheerful voice rang out from behind me.
dialogues.text: Miharu's cheerful voice rang out from behind me.

dialogues.jp: 「朝から元気だな」
dialogues.en: "Always bright in the morning as usual, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Always bright in the morning as usual, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、少なくとも俺と比べたらな」
dialogues.en: "Yup, especially compared to me."
dialogues.text: "Yup, especially compared to me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩が元気なさすぎるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "You should be more cheery in the morning!"
dialogues.text: "You should be more cheery in the morning!"

dialogues.jp: まぁ、元気だとは言わんがな。
dialogues.en: Bah, enough talk about that.
dialogues.text: Bah, enough talk about that.

dialogues.jp:
「ところで美春、音夢に挨拶していかなくてい
　いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway Miharu, why didn't you say good morning to Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway Miharu, why didn't you say good morning to Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
話している間に、校門を通り過ぎてしまってい
る。
dialogues.en: As we were talking, we passed right by the school gates.
dialogues.text: As we were talking, we passed right by the school gates.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「え？　あぁ、いつの間にか通りすぎてしまっ
　たんです！？」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh?! Of course I do, I do that every day!"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh?! Of course I do, I do that every day!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「今さっきだよ」
dialogues.en: "Then what about just now?"
dialogues.text: "Then what about just now?"

dialogues.jp:
苦笑いを浮かべながら、同じように笑みをこぼ
している音夢に軽く手をふる。
dialogues.en:
Grinning, I gave a light wave to Nemu wearing the same grin
and waving back.
dialogues.text:
Grinning, I gave a light wave to Nemu wearing the same grin
and waving back.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あっとっと……それじゃ朝倉先輩。アデュー
　です！」
dialogues.en: "Oh no... I'd see you later Asakura-senpai. Adieu!"
dialogues.text: "Oh no... I'd see you later Asakura-senpai. Adieu!"

dialogues.jp:
すたこらさっさと、美春がもと来た道を戻って
いく。
dialogues.en: Miharu immediately ran back the way we came.
dialogues.text: Miharu immediately ran back the way we came.

dialogues.jp: ほんと、忠実なわんこだ……。
dialogues.en: What a faithful little thing she is...
dialogues.text: What a faithful little thing she is...

dialogues.jp: とぼとぼと歩を進め、昇降口に向かう。
dialogues.en: I continue through the school entrance.
dialogues.text: I continue through the school entrance.

dialogues.jp: ◆忠実なわんこ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Faithful Puppy◆
dialogues.text: ◆Faithful Puppy◆

dialogues.jp:
校門では、音夢が立っていた。風紀委員の仕
事って奴だな。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was standing at the school gates, fufilling her
Discplinary Committee work.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was standing at the school gates, fufilling her
Discplinary Committee work.

dialogues.jp: そして、元気いっぱいの美春がやって来た。
dialogues.en: Then, the incredibly cheerful Miharu came by.
dialogues.text: Then, the incredibly cheerful Miharu came by.

dialogues.jp:
美春は、音夢に挨拶するのを忘れたのに気が
付くと、校門へと行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Miharu, completely forgetting to greet Nemu as she passed by
the school gates, immediately dashed back once I reminded
her of it.
dialogues.text:
Miharu, completely forgetting to greet Nemu as she passed by
the school gates, immediately dashed back once I reminded
her of it.

dialogues.jp: ほんと、忠実なわんこだよ……。
dialogues.en: What a faithful little thing she is...
dialogues.text: What a faithful little thing she is...
